components.text: The boundary between one-shot and persistent operations matters. Trigger operations call trigger when a condition occurs; persistent operations register with world state or tick

pages.text: sets and unregister when the array ends.

$(f:minecraft:uniform)PersistentOp.activate -> register(level)
PersistentOp.deactivate -> unregister(level)
TriggerOp.shouldTrigger -> trigger(context)
OnDiscard -> release$(/f)

• LoopOp updates a world tick table instead of creating a scheduler per entity.
• RemoveOnHit and WaterBurst treat collisions as trigger boundaries.
